defs.def: fully prepared for what you are going to do 准备好；准备完毕

ex.s: Back in 1951, Reisley was just 26, newly married and ready to put down roots.
ex.t: 早在1951年，Reisley只有26岁，新婚不久，准备安家扎根。

ex.s: Sitting at the table, making my mini sandwich, I realised I was ready for our next chapter.
ex.t: 生下双胞胎后，作者和丈夫决定________。

ex.s: Going to the cafe starts her day off good and gets her ready for class.
ex.t: 成功只会敲一次门。

ex.s: Become ready to use.
ex.t: 变得随时可用。

ex.s: It's more challenging to eat in moderation if you have unhealthy snacks at the ready, like cookies. ____18____
ex.t: 如果你随时有不健康的零食，比如饼干，要做到适量饮食会更加困难。____

ex.s: She was fully ready for her first rehearsal.
ex.t: 你可能需要等超过24小时才能赶上下一班。

ex.s: I’d just arrived at school, ready for another school day.
ex.t: 我刚到学校，准备开始新的一天。

ex.s: After two months we were all prepared and ready to go on stage.
ex.t: 两个月后，我们都准备好了，可以登台了。

ex.s: “I’m ready to ____40____.” And shine she did.
ex.t: “我已经准备好____40____了。”而她确实大放异彩。

ex.s: Chances are that if you’re looking to live a more sustainable lifestyle, not everyone around you will be ready to jump on that bandwagon.
ex.t: 如果你正想过一种更可持续的生活方式，很有可能不是你周围每个人都准备好加入这趟潮流。

ex.s: As another winter sets in, I’m more than ready to embrace the cold again.
ex.t: 当又一个冬天来临时，我已经准备好再次拥抱寒冷了。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天都会有所不同，但学生必须准备好完成简短的课堂写作或测试，这些内容直接来自指定阅读材料或上一堂课的讲座/讨论笔记，因此上课时仔细记笔记很重要。

ex.s: “I was turning the page to get ready for the next page, but the draft wind from the turn caused the spare pages to fall off the stand,” Mr Titterton said, “Luckily I was able to catch them and put them back.”
ex.t: "我在翻页准备下一页时，翻页带起的气流把多余的乐谱从谱架上吹落了，"蒂特顿先生说，"幸好我接住了它们并把它们放回去。"

ex.s: Damage changes us before we are ready.
ex.t: 在我们准备好之前伤害就已经改变了我们。

ex.s: Motivation letter：You should have your motivation letter ready before filling out the application form．
ex.t: 动机信：你应该在填写申请表之前准备好动机信．

ex.s: With everything ready, Bernard started out on his new business.
ex.t: 成为下一个明星记者、新闻撰稿人、导演或制片人。

ex.s: He's not ready to retire, but he's found a new hobby to keep his hands skillful in the years to come.
ex.t: 他还没准备好退休，但他找到了一个新爱好，让他的双手在未来几年里保持灵巧。

ex.s: “I wouldn’t have duo ask you, but my teacher, Mr Mills, says I am ready.
ex.t: "是的，先生，"她回答道，她深色的眼睛注视着他。

ex.s: Gordon says his students are emailing daily with NASA engineers about the problem, readying a workable solution to test in space.
ex.t: 32.我们对国际空间站的细菌有什么了解？

ex.s: 16．（30分）I was ready to pay for my bananas at the grocery one night， when fear seized me． My wallet was gone． I could only have left it on the G9 bus， which was now speeding in the dark to some（1）     station．
ex.t: C．会完成

ex.s: Exercising makes you more awake and ready to handle whatever is ahead of you for the day.
ex.t: 锻炼使你更加清醒，准备好应对当天面临的任何事情。

ex.s: I woke up sweating and nervous, but ready to prove something to myself.
ex.t: 事实上，我和第一名得到的是同样的奖牌。

ex.s: The plants get ready to fight back.
ex.t: 植物准备好反击。

ex.s: The plants get ready to fight back.
ex.t: 植物准备好反击。

defs.def: completed and available to be used 已完成；准备好；可利用

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日那天我们收集物品的所有努力终于汇聚在一起．当我看到我们收集的各种物资时我突然意识到我们当天要制作的每一个包裹最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中．在过去四个月里我从没想过项目完成后我会是什么感觉．在制作包裹的过程中我意识到我已经忘记了它背后的真正意义．我只把它当作又一个学校项目而且我想在这个项目上取得好成绩．当包裹完成准备运往海外时那种温暖的感觉是我永远不会忘记的．

defs.def: available to be used easily and immediately 方便使用的；现成的
willing and quick to do or give sth 愿意迅速做某事（或给某物）；急于行动

ex.s: They also need to be ready to give ___61___ (interview) in English with international journalists.
ex.t: 他们还需要随时准备用英语接受国际记者的___61___（interview）采访。

defs.def: likely to do sth very soon 马上要，很可能即将（做某事）

ex.s: GET READY TO MAKE SOME MUSIC!
ex.t: 准备来点音乐吧！

ex.s: I know we should eat more fresh fruit and vegetables, but ready meals are so convenient.
ex.t: 我知道我们应该多吃新鲜水果和蔬菜，但即食食品太方便了。

ex.s: It is not advisable to be early, as the host may not be ready.
ex.t: 不宜太早到，因为主人可能还没准备好。

ex.s: By the end of the run, all my stress has disappeared and I'm ready to face the next day at work.
ex.t: 跑步结束时，我所有的压力都消失了，我准备好迎接第二天的工作。

ex.s: After running, 6_____ and he is ready to face the next day at work.
ex.t: 跑步后，______，他就准备好迎接第二天的工作了。

defs.def: needing sth as soon as possible 急需；需尽快得到
quick and clever 聪明的；机敏的
